stdout:
Delete live chat messages. Use this tool to remove messages from a live chat by their IDs.

Usage:
  yutu liveChatMessage delete [flags]

Examples:
# Delete a live chat message by ID
yutu liveChatMessage delete --ids abc123
# Delete multiple live chat messages
yutu liveChatMessage delete --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help          help for delete
  -i, --ids strings   IDs of the live chat messages to delete
      --yes           Confirm the operation
